meta_home_description: WSGuild creates workshops and tools for digital adventures.
hero_desc: We create thoughtful tools and workshops that make digital adventures easier to create, develop, and enjoy with friends.
intro_text: One guild — several workshops: independent workshops and practical tools for players and creators.
programs_lead: Choose a direction and enter the part of the guild dedicated to it.
program_1_desc: Create your own locations, from a shed to entire kingdoms. Compatible with Guild TABLETOP.
program_2_desc: Bring your adventure to life with friends.
program_3_desc: Create and manage your character. Compatible with Guild TABLETOP.
callout_title: Create and play your own adventure without unnecessary complexity.
callout_text: Tutorial videos are available for every tool and workshop.
products_intro: Standalone programs designed as complete projects to make your boldest ideas easier to realize.
product_ccl_desc: A dedicated workspace for creating characters step by step. CCL keeps the process clear, structured, and convenient during play.
product_ccl_feature_2: Important character details in one place
product_ccl_feature_3: A focused interface for long creative sessions
principle_1_desc: Each project solves a clear problem without becoming overloaded.
principle_2_desc: The interface explains itself and keeps important actions close.
principle_3_desc: Projects grow through practical improvements and feedback.
tools_intro: Compact utilities made to simplify routine work and keep useful actions close at hand.
tools_catalog_intro: The cabinet is prepared for focused utilities grouped by purpose.
tool_1_desc: Helpers that remove repetitive steps and keep common actions within reach.
tool_2_desc: Focused workspaces for organizing ideas, references, and reusable material.
tool_3_desc: Simple instruments for preparing, checking, and moving useful information.
tools_note_text: This page is ready for real tool cards as soon as their names, links, and release statuses are available.
